description: Shop/MyRoom/channel batch gate: wires #207 reference captures, #208 input traces, and the live-Memoryer leg into one manifest with explicit thresholds. Offline rows run headless (no Xvfb, no window, no OS input); live rows are opt-in (--live) and reported separately as interop evidence.
platform: linux-x86_64 headless (snapshot seam + scripted CLI, virtual audio only)

run_policy.audio: PULSE_SINK must be a null/virtual sink; scripted runs never touch the speakers
run_policy.display: no display claimed or touched (no Xvfb, no window)
run_policy.isolation: one out-dir per scenario run under <out>/<stamp>/; preflight claims released at the end
run_policy.verdicts: passed | failed | skipped | needs_review; a skip is never a pass; needs_review never counts as a pass
run_policy.gate_exit: 0 iff failed == 0 and preflight passed (needs_review and skipped are loud, not silent)
run_policy.toolchain: recorded per run (cargo/rustc/python3/Memoryer/commit); reproduce from the recorded versions

rows.expected: green row: all checks pass (or the capture skips cleanly without data)
known_open: parity Input OPENs are out of this path (filters, search, set-item, gift, ITEMGEM join, cart totals, download); next step per docs/parity/shop.md is a live-shop SendInput sweep, not this row.
